Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC7 A statement that reaches another service's schema is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a statement of the lot release reaches a table of another service's schema
    When the statement runs in the build
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC8 The lot row changes only after the decision record is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision record is written with its rule ID and the package version in force
    When the lot release runs and the same Idempotency-Key is sent again
    Then the lot row is released once, and the repeat writes nothing and answers no second move

  Scenario: AC9 The window and the reference values come from the package and no operation or schedule is declared (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the Debt sale rule package is in force at its version
    When the window and the LOV values are read
    Then the window is a durable workflow timer, the values carry their version, and no REST operation or Schedule is registered

  Scenario: AC10 A retried or timed-out activity writes nothing twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the activity barBuyer is retried or times out
    When the retry runs
    Then nothing is written twice and the case move is answered once

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call that fails or does not answer holds the step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-partner contract mock does not answer inside 2 s
    When the bar step calls the panel read
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's schedule, nothing is written and no move is answered
